purpose: Full-backbone adaptation with public adult overhead cattle plus fixed early calf frames; final windows remain unopened
identity_labels: All eight calf IDs map to one cow class for localization only. No ID classifier is trained here.

selection.criterion: Calibration F1; deterministic ties favor higher precision, then higher threshold

limits: Previously inspected segments are development data, never final test data.
Final and reserve windows stay unopened until model, threshold and recognition policies are frozen.
Same-video localization adaptation is not evidence of generalization to another farm.
Use a separate adult-cow scene as a disclosed additional regression; no test labels used for fitting.
Second-stage settings chosen after first development/calibration results; no new blind-test claim for those segments.

adult_data.split: Publisher Detection_and_localisation Train partition only; distinct train/val JSON files
adult_data.selection: Evenly spaced image-ID-sorted indices using numpy.linspace
adult_data.boxes: Publisher rounded top-left xywh plus radians converted to enclosing axis-aligned rectangles and clipped; all instances class cow
